How We Tailor It Around Your Columbus Business

You don't need to learn complicated software. We scope, configure, and walk through the workflow with you step by step.

📲

1. Instant Missed-Call Text-Back

The second a call goes unanswered or hits voicemail, our AI texts the customer from a local 614/740 number: "Sorry we missed your call! How can we help today?" before they can dial your competitor.

🤖

2. Trained on Your Exact Services

Customized with your service areas (Columbus, Dublin, Westerville, Grove City, Hilliard, Upper Arlington, etc.), pricing rules, emergency triage, and hours of operation.

🔔

3. Instant Lead Summary to Your Phone

Once the AI collects their name, phone number, street address, issue details, and preferred time window, it texts the complete qualified lead straight to your cell.
